title: Control Testing and Evidence Review
summary: Build a traceable control-testing workpaper from a defined population, explicit criteria, and inspectable evidence.
audience: Control testers, quality reviewers, and process owners
decision: What conclusions does the tested evidence support, and what must a reviewer resolve?
report_sections: Limitations quality review and human disposition

findings.title: Required review occurred after the test criterion deadline
findings.detail: R03 was reviewed two fictional business days after receipt against an illustrative one-business-day criterion. One of two selected C01 records failed.
findings.recommendation: Investigate delay, assess affected records, and submit a retest plan for human approval.

findings.title: Missing review evidence prevents an operating conclusion
findings.detail: R06 has no accessible execution evidence. Absence of evidence is recorded separately from a demonstrated missed review.
findings.recommendation: Obtain the archive record or document why it cannot be recovered; retain the restriction.

findings.title: Release approval lacks separation from the preparer
findings.detail: C03 permits the preparer to approve release; R08 used that design.
findings.recommendation: Propose a distinct reviewer control and test implementation before closure.

evidence.title: Fictional control population, criteria, and execution log

metrics.label: Selection coverage
metrics.method: Selected population IDs / supplied population IDs; not statistical assurance.

metrics.label: Confirmed sample deviations
metrics.method: FAIL / selected; one additional selected record is unable to conclude.

limitations: Judgmental selection does not support a population deviation estimate.
Eight records are the complete fictional input population, not a live operational population.
The assistant is not an independent organizational reviewer.
One missing execution record prevents a C02 operating conclusion.
conclusion: Two confirmed deviations and one unresolved evidence gap were identified among five selected instances from eight fictional opportunities. C03 has a design gap; judgmental selection does not support a population deviation estimate, and human review remains pending.
report_narrative: Two confirmed deviations and one unresolved evidence gap were identified in five selected instances from eight fictional opportunities. The evidence supports a restricted workpaper conclusion; it does not estimate the population deviation rate.

The fixture contains four C01 opportunities, three C02 opportunities, and one C03 opportunity. Five records were selected: two C01, two C02, and the sole C03 event. Criteria and the fictional business-day calendar were defined before interpreting outcomes.

R03 missed the illustrative timing criterion, R06 lacks accessible execution evidence, and R08 lacks a separate approver. C03 also has a design gap because its procedure permits preparer self-approval. Missing R06 evidence does not prove nonperformance.

C01 and C02 designs are adequate for their stated fictional objectives; C03 is inadequate. C01 and C02 selections are judgmental, including a targeted archive concern, while C03 is a census of one event. The fixture does not establish an independent organizational reviewer, and the assistant cannot supply that independence.

TestResults contains two PASS, two FAIL, and one UNABLE TO CONCLUDE result. Selection coverage is 5/8 = 62.5%; confirmed deviations among selected records are 2/5 = 40.0%. The conclusive-only rate of 2/4 = 50.0% must be shown with the missing record retained in the original denominator.

SYN-001 contains the full fictional population, criteria, and execution log. R06 may reflect an archive failure or an execution failure; recovering contemporaneous evidence would distinguish those explanations. Public FFIEC references support method context, not the synthetic findings.

Proposed actions are to investigate R03 timing, obtain or resolve R06 evidence, and redesign C03 approval separation. Retest should use fresh post-change instances and retain the original deviations; a corrected historical record alone does not demonstrate sustained operation.
QA must reconcile 5 = 2 + 2 + 1 and reject population inference from the judgmental selection. Human review remains pending for severity, scope expansion, independence, remediation, and closure.
